steps.requirements: Implement Express middleware that validates JWT tokens from the Authorization header. Return 401 for missing/invalid tokens. Extract user info from the token payload and attach to req.user.
steps.changeAnalysis:
src/middleware/auth.ts: new file with verifyToken middleware
src/types/express.d.ts: extend Express Request with user property
package.json: add jsonwebtoken dependency
steps.tests: Run `npm test` — auth middleware tests must pass. Test valid token, expired token, missing header, malformed token.
steps.humanConfirmationSteps: Check middleware returns 401 for invalid tokens. Check valid token passes through to next handler with req.user populated.
